source: Public rendered card HTML and app-js.js Videos.show_smb_popup/show_filmoscop_popup

capabilities.rule: Use the complete cnstart:// URI embedded in the card HTML. The frontend replaces only cnstart:// with smb:// on non-Windows systems. Do not infer a private server address from Video.fs.
capabilities.windows_copy_rule: For display/copy, the frontend removes cnstart: and replaces / with backslash.
capabilities.requires: An installed handler/SMB client and network access to the returned private operator share.
capabilities.not_tested: External application launch, credentials and successful share access. No software was installed.

capabilities.rule: Pass the returned URI to the registered external player. The hostname is part of the URI and must not be rewritten to video.karelia.pro.
capabilities.requires: A registered iptvvideo URI handler, linked by the website to its TV/player installer page.
capabilities.not_tested: Actual external player/device playback. No software was installed.
